# Research Execution Record
Depth: Deep
Coverage plan: governing rule; application; conflicts; recommendation
Date range: enacted and effective requirements through 2026-08-28
Geography or jurisdiction: selected U.S. jurisdictions
Source policy: controlling legal sources and official guidance; press releases used only for issuer announcements
Search lanes: authority; application; challenge; scope; freshness
Sources opened: https://example.com/rule
Access escalation: official rule page failed once in the default fetcher, then opened through an available interactive browser
Corroboration: performed across controlling and independent sources
Disconfirming route: searched for reversals, contrary authority, and scope exceptions
Conflicts: reconciled through dates and controlling jurisdiction
Evidence gaps: none material
Critical recheck: independently reopened and checked the highest-impact rule and effective date
Stop rationale: all consequential slots were supported or bounded and additional targeted searches converged
